verdict.rationale: Medusa is a commerce platform, so an in-person point-of-sale sharing catalog, inventory, and customers with the online store is a fair question. The evidence never shows Medusa shipping a POS. It only says its framework and modules 'can be used to support' PoS systems, which is a developer building block rather than a delivered capability. The Sales Channel and Inventory module entries are bare titles that never describe in-person selling.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell in person with a point-of-sale that shares the same catalog, inventory, and customers as my online store
